**Build from scratch around Haaland's armband — the season starts here.**

**✅ What's strong**
This 5-3-2 is a £100.0m machine projecting a 54.94-point XI haul in Gameweek 1. Haaland is the obvious captain — nailed, on pens, and carrying elite 0.86 xGI/90. The defensive engine room is where the value sits: Senesi (4.85 xP), Tarkowski (4.75) and Guéhi (4.55) all rack up DEFCON +2 most weeks. B.Fernandes (4.66) brings pens and free-kick duties, while Thiago (4.60) is a smart cut-price second striker on spot-kicks. No flagged fitness doubts to worry about.

**🔄 What I'd change**
Building fresh, so prioritise the spine: lock in Haaland up top and pair him with Thiago to free up funds. Load the back five with volume defenders — Senesi, Tarkowski, Guéhi — and add cheap enablers Thiaw (£5.0m, 4.29 xP) and O'Shea (£4.0m, 4.19) to fund the premiums. In midfield, Fernandes plus DEFCON man Anderson (4.61) gives points floor and ceiling.

**Bottom line:** Haaland captain, a DEFCON-heavy defence, and Fernandes pulling strings — this is a squad built to bank points from minute one.
